about.description: KWEB is an ETF perpetual listed on Gate, tracking KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 4h. Up to 25x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
